notes: On phones, the tabs now sit along the bottom within thumb reach. The + in the middle logs a payment, logs everything Paid as planned, or adds a debt. Settings is the gear at the top.
This Month has a Calendar view: the month at a glance with a dot on each due date. Tap a day to see what's due and log it.

App lock: ask for a PIN, or Face ID / fingerprint, before your numbers show. Turn it on in Settings. It's a screen lock, so your data stays on your device as before. If you forget your PIN, the lock comes off after a one-minute wait; your numbers are never at risk.
